newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Corrosion may be cause of Russia gas blast - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Corrosion may be cause of Russia gas blast - Tass.

text.p: An explosion on a gas pipeline in south-western Russia on Sunday sent flames shooting 30 metres (100 feet) into the air, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said the blast occurred on a stretch of pipeline close to the town of Maloyaroslavlets. No one was injured but emergency services took five hours to extinguish the blaze.
The Ministry for Emergency Situations declined to comment on the incident.

Ekho Moskvy agency quoted authorities as saying the explosion had been caused by gas leaking from a corroded pipe installed some 20 years ago. The damaged branch of the pipeline had been closed for repairs.
A similar explosion occurred in the same area on January 28 as a result of corrosion in pipes damaged during installation.
